title: Mackerel Sushi Rolls
description: A simple and flavorful sushi recipe using mackerel as the main ingredient. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to the package instructions.
Cut the mackerel into thin slices.
Cut the nori sheet into desired size for rolling.
Prepare a flat surface for rolling the sushi.
Lay a sheet of nori flat on the surface.
Spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto the nori.
Place the mackerel slices in the middle of the rice.
Add green onions and sesame seeds on top of the mackerel.
Roll the sushi using a bamboo sushi mat.
Slice the sushi into individual pieces.
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi.
